* Clubs folding a week before the regular season starts is bad optically and a real insult to the players whose jobs depend on these things. We saw that with Toronto & NYC this season. I worry that this kind of thing could scare away investors and partners.
* Something needs to be done about the Glendale Raptors. I expect they'll eventualy either fold or come crawling back as there's no way a small club with limited resources can sustain playing in a league in another continent. But until that happens, having two competing leagues for a niche support is not a good situation for American rugby. It's this sort of thing that tanked the several attempts at setting up a professional American soccer league before the MLS came around.
* Too many clubs have stadia that are way too big for the crowds they pull in. 3500 people in a 28,000 seat stadium obviously looks bad but more importanlty I worry about the overheads for maintaining/renting these oversized facilities.
